title_hi: Identity और habits: studies क्या मापते हैं?
unique_angle: Identity self-report, repeated behavior, context, automaticity, and longitudinal habit-strength scores are separate variables; an identity label is not causal proof or a fixed trait.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed research and longitudinal field study
safety_boundary: Public education only. No diagnosis, treatment, prescription, individualized behavioral plan, fixed habit-formation timeline, guaranteed behavior change, permanent identity label, or inference of hidden personality from a proxy measure.
